verdict_reason: The new snags are well sourced, but S-18 misstates what the address book API enforces on country and three snags cite code names the roles rename removed.

todos.issue: S-18's Built line tells product 'The address book API accepts any country for any type.' The API refuses it for the receiving side: AddressRequest is annotated @ReceivingRolesInTheUnitedKingdom, and its Javadoc (AddressRequest.java:25-27) says an address holding a consignee, importer or place of destination role must be in the United Kingdom; RoleGroup.RECEIVING is inTheUnitedKingdom. Option (b)'s 'should the API refuse a UK send-side address as well' is asked against a wrong picture of what the API does today.
todos.fix: Must: S-18 states what the API enforces now: any country for the sending and branch roles, the United Kingdom only for consignee, importer and place of destination. One way: replace the sentence with 'The address book API accepts any country for a sending role and refuses a non-UK consignee, importer or place of destination (ReceivingRolesInTheUnitedKingdom).'

todos.issue: S-09, S-11 and S-14 point the designer at code names the same PR set renamed when uses became roles, so the cited code cannot be found: line 85 copy.en.js uses.legendByAddressType (now roles.legendByAddressType, copy.en.js:104-108); line 101 list.uses and uses.options (now list.roles, copy.en.js:38, and roles); line 125 USES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE and useItemsOf (now ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE, address-book-tabs.js:10, and roleItemsOf, add.controller.js:128). S-17 and S-18, added the same week, already say roles.
todos.fix: Must: every Built line in S-09 to S-18 names code that exists at ins-frontend PR #71's head. One way: rename the cited keys and functions to their roles names, keeping the user-facing words ('uses question') where they describe the page.
